name: Lich Baz'hial
guide_text: Definitely hero power + buy spell on turn 1 if you can, level on turn 2, and hero power + buy on turn 3. You don't have to hero power after that unless you really need the gold.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for at most 3 gold. Extremely mediocre buddy.
